CVE-2026-106535.title: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX for ...
CVE-2026-106535.description: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.
